svg.aria-label: Dumbbell Squat, Stand: Hold a dumbbell at each side with both feet planted.
svg.title: Dumbbell Squat, Stand: Hold a dumbbell at each side with both feet planted.

svg.aria-label: Dumbbell Squat, Lower: Bend your hips and knees together and keep your chest up.
svg.title: Dumbbell Squat, Lower: Bend your hips and knees together and keep your chest up.

svg.aria-label: Dumbbell Squat, Bottom: Lower until your thighs are about parallel, with the weights at your sides.
svg.title: Dumbbell Squat, Bottom: Lower until your thighs are about parallel, with the weights at your sides.

svg.aria-label: Dumbbell Squat, Stand up: Push through your whole foot to stand.
svg.title: Dumbbell Squat, Stand up: Push through your whole foot to stand.
